text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait takes part in marine environment seminar in Japan.
- Lawyers' society calls for protest at courts' complex after lawyer was allegedly attacked by plaintiff.
- Kuwait arrests 20 people who allegedly tried to enter the country illegally.
- Kuwait Natioanl Petroleum Company introduces new prices for oil products in November.
- National Guard complete joint exercises with American and British troops.

- Kuwait welcomes United Nations oil-for-food deal with Iraq for the sake of the Iraqi people. Kuwait's former occupier Iraq on Monday accepted U.N. terms for limited oil exports to finance the import of much-needed food and medicine.
